title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1+2 ME POST PARKIMI TEK KODRA E DIELLIT ! 230,000 €
description_sq:

Organizimi: 2 dhoma gjumi, sallon ndenjeje me ambient gatimi, 2 tualete (njëri me dritare)

Parkim i dedikuar dhe depo e veçuar për më shumë hapësirë ruajtjeje
Totalisht i mobiluar, me mobilim bashkëkohor dhe cilësor
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 WITH PARKING POST AT KODRA E DIELLE! €230,000
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale with parking space and storage included in the price near the entrance of Residence Kodra e Diellit 1. An ideal opportunity for those looking for comfort, natural light and modern style in one of the most sought after areas of Tirana! 🏠 Main details: Area: 95.6 m² gross / 83 m² net Organization: 2 bedrooms, living room with kitchen area, 2 bathrooms (one with window) 2 balconies with open view 3rd technical floor, of a new construction, of 2024 Orientation South-East - abundant lighting throughout the day Dedicated parking and separate warehouse for more storage space Fully furnished furnished, with contemporary and quality furniture
